title: Declarative agents: what Copilot runs for you, what it needs and where to stop it
summary: The documented controls and capability-specific licensing are supported. Minor corrections should name the applyOnce mode property, acknowledge conflicting Microsoft guidance on hosting and SharePoint licensing, and add the missing source citations.

claims.claim: Microsoft 365 admin center > Agents > All agents > agent > Block > Block agent blocks the selected agent for the organization.
claims.quote: Select Agents > All agents. ... select an agent from the list of agents. ... select Block or Unblock. ... select either Block agent or Unblock agent, and then select Save.
